notes: Workspaces (Work and Create): a project that remembers. It keeps a brief, style, standing notes for each specialist agent (Researcher, Writer, Designer, Reviewer, Builder) and a summary of everything it has made, and every run in it reads all of that
Task list: queue several tasks in a workspace and Echelon runs them one after another, each building on the last
Workspaces sync with Google Drive and are included in backups
